text:
riley: hey everyone, first day! quick setup snags: Okta asked me to register a passkey but the browser says 'No platform authenticator found'. Drive welcome folder not in My Drive, and 1Password invite still pending. who do I poke?

it-support: welcome @riley :wave: which OS and browser are you on? passkeys need a recent Chrome/Edge on macOS or Windows with platform authenticator enabled.
riley: macOS Sonoma 14.4, using Brave (chromium-based). I tried Safari too and get the same message.
it-support: Brave can block WebAuthn by default in some privacy settings. Try Chrome stable or check Brave -> Settings -> Shields -> disable for okta.redwood.ai and retry the passkey enrollment.
riley: switched to Chrome, enrollment started but after touching the device it errors: "Attestation refused". any tips?
it-support: that usually means attestation choices in the SSO config are strict. We've had users succeed by replugging the YubiKey (if hardware) or enabling full attestation temporarily. If you're using built-in passkey, try creating a local passkey in Settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys first then enroll.
riley: i created a passkey locally and Okta accepted it! thanks.
docs-bot: Quick tip: if you need the Welcome materials, open drive.google.com/drive/shared-with-me and search "Welcome to Redwood" then Add shortcut to Drive.
people-ops: 1Password seats sometimes wait on final provisioning. @people-ops here 44b i've triggered the SaaS sync for riley@redwood.ai. expect invite within 15 minutes.
riley: got the 1Password invite and Drive shortcut. All set! Thanks for the rapid help :tada:
it-support: awesome, welcome aboard @riley. ping this thread if anything else pops up during your first week.
